summary: Iter28 acceptance: verified (a) trip_import cid-shadow bug FIXED — imported trips are correctly stamped with company_id (not customer_id) and are visible via GET /api/trips; (b) multi-company isolation of imports — trips imported under Company A do NOT leak to Company B; (c) /api/auth/me returns 200 with test session; (d) Playwright demo-login-button flow — button visible on /login, click navigates to /dashboard, localStorage.session_token == 'test_session_bitumen_2026', dashboard renders with sidebar + KPI cards. Full regression 37/37 pytest green (34 prior + 3 new).
action_items: Static preview URL (.preview.static.emergentagent.com) still needs a rebuild with correct REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to fix the 404 sign-in issue there. The dynamic preview URL works fine and the demo-login bypass works on both. This is outside the sub-agent's scope (build/deploy).

The demo login bypass is intentional/temporary — flag for removal before production. Currently anybody with the URL can access owner@vbklogistics.test data.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter28 verified the cid shadow-bug fix (trips.py:230 cid->cust_id) and demo-login-button flow. Both are fully working. When running the full regression, prefer sequential execution (add `-o addopts=` to override pytest-xdist parallel) — multi_company_iso and other tests share entity names and can collide in parallel workers. Static preview URL sign-in 404 is a build/deploy issue outside code scope.
rca of the issue: cid shadow bug in trips.py trip_import: outer `cid = await _active_company_id(...)` was overwritten inside loop by `cid = cust_by_name.get(cname.lower())`, so d['company_id'] = cid was setting company_id to the customer's id — imported trips were invisible to list endpoints filtering by (user_id, company_id). Fix: renamed inner variable to `cust_id`. Verified by asserting trip.company_id == active_company_id and trip.company_id != cust_id in test_iter28_import_and_demo.py.
